history.overview: The Chantry served as the ceremonial heart of the Ocean God’s worship, now corrupted by Discord energy.

timeline.name: Chantry Constructed
timeline.description: Built by an ancient aquatic civilization as a sacred ceremonial hall.

timeline.name: Ritual Channels Activated
timeline.description: Water channels were used to amplify oceanic planar energy.

timeline.name: Discord Corruption
timeline.description: Discord ruptures twisted water flows and corrupted ritual altars.

timeline.name: Muramite Assault
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to seize the Chantry’s ritual power.
